title: Evaluation of Thiosemicarbazones Compound derivatives as Antitumor
abstract: Thiosemicarbazones (TSCs) are a type of Schiff bases which are commonly synthesized by condensing thiosemicarbazide with an aldehyde or ketone. The wide range of pharmacological effects exhibited by TSCs, including antiviral, antibacterial, antitubercular, antiprotozoal, antimalarial, antifungal, enzyme inhibitory and notably, antitumor properties, have made them a subject of interest for researchers in the fields of chemistry and biology.
